- **Status:** Ready
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** tooling (M; v0.1 bar 1)
- **Milestone:** Purpose: verifiability, preserved intent and reviewability
- **Source:** The v0.1 public preview bar (docs/release/v0.1-bar.md) and Decider D121 (2026-10-29).
- **Depends on:** none
- **Story:** As Dana, I want to install the Phrase CLI with one dotnet tool command, so that I can try Phrase without building it from source.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given src/Phrase.Cli, When dotnet pack runs, Then a tool package is produced with the command name phrase, one version defined in one place, and a placeholder package id recorded as pending the product owner's choice (one-way door)
  2. Given the packed tool, When it is installed from a local folder feed, Then phrase --version prints the package version and phrase build works on the Tasks demo
  3. Given the existing tests and CI, When the card is merged, Then none is removed and the generated C# is unchanged
